title: Implement searchApis Tool
description: Create tool that searches API catalog by keyword. Must accept keyword parameter, search across id, path, and summary fields, return matching endpoints, perform case-insensitive search, and handle empty results gracefully.
details: Sprint 1 - API Catalog Tools. Enables keyword-based API discovery.
testStrategy: Test with various keywords, verify case-insensitivity, test with no results, verify search across all fields.
